caption: The video captures a calm, dark-green pond bordered by floating patches of algae and duckweed near the top edge. On the left, a large dark wading bird resembling a heron stands nearly motionless on a small algae-covered islet. Its long pointed beak is held forward, and its shadowy reflection ripples beneath it. To the right, a loose cluster of five small brown ducks paddles about on the open water. The ducks continuously shift their relative positions within the group, some turning their heads while others drift and turn slowly. Their movement sends concentric ripples expanding outward across the glassy surface. The standing bird remains on its islet throughout, showing only the faintest adjustment of posture, while the gentle motion of the ducks keeps the water in constant, quiet movement.
relations: Ducks paddling on open water generate concentric ripples that expand outward across the surface.
Heron standing on the algae islet casts a rippling reflection directly beneath its body.
Continuous duck movement keeps the pond surface in constant gentle motion while the heron stays fixed.
Heron posture adjustments remain minimal, preserving its nearly motionless stance on the islet.
